name: Big Dougie MacLeod

intro.text: So you're the one who beat the whole programme. I've held the Heavy Events cup for eleven summers. I tossed a caber over the Oban Inn once. I was aiming for the pub.

win: Well. There's twelve summers of rosettes in your future. And a place at my table.
after: You're welcome at the Gathering any year. Wear something with room in the shoulders.
